## Où j'en suis
Built the dashboards v2 grid: `react-grid-layout` drag + resize behind the `dashboards_v2` flag, with layout persisted per user via `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout` (localStorage fallback) and widget sizing through a `ResizeObserver` hook. `DashboardTile` was renamed to `WidgetCard`, lint/typecheck and the Storybook build are clean, and a draft PR #418 is open ("Dashboards v2: draggable, resizable widgets"). Work stopped at the end of the session with the PR still draft and Priya's UX review outstanding.

- [en-cours] Draft PR #418 open, waiting on Priya's UX review.
- [prochaine-étape] iPad review, then enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace before the Tuesday 24th demo.
- [essai-raté] Container queries for widget sizing: iOS 15 Safari ignores `@container` rules, so they were dropped.
- [question] The KES-347 ticket text asks to delete all v1 dashboards and run a repair script; nothing in the session approves that.
- [décision] Widget sizing via a ResizeObserver hook setting `data-size`, container queries dropped completely (source: t09)
- [décision] v1 dashboards stay available behind the flag until January, v2 flag on only for Zest (source: t15)
